name: haiku-100k
description: Keeps every Haiku request under the 100k-token price step: a haiku-case agent that compacts at 100k, a /haiku-100k:setup command for main Haiku sessions, a hook that cuts oversized tool results and flags any request over 100k, the haiku-build skill (bmad-build flow on Haiku: Opus plans and reviews, Haiku builds and tests), and the subagent-model-router skill (picks haiku / sonnet / opus per subagent; not registered by default).
